whenToUse: You report an urgent, time-bound situation, such as an imminent sign-out or work about to be lost.
You must get a response before people continue.
The system has to raise a warning without anyone clicking.
whenNotToUse: You're asking whether to run the button people just pressed (use a confirmation dialog).
It's a light notice that's fine to miss.
It's status information that can stay on screen without a response (use an alert banner).

alternatives.name: Confirmation Dialog
alternatives.reason: Asking whether to continue something people started.

alternatives.name: Alert Banner
alternatives.reason: A warning that stays visible without a response.

alternatives.name: Toast
alternatives.reason: A result that can show briefly and disappear.

accessibility: role="alertdialog" with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby reads the title and description as soon as it opens.
showModal() blocks the background, and clicking the backdrop doesn't close it. Esc counts as the cancel response (sign out).
On open, focus goes to the button that resolves the situation (Stay signed in).
Give the countdown role="timer" so it isn't read every second, and say in the description what happens when time runs out.
